security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, if any of mscratch, mepc, mcause, or mtval CSR registers is not instantiated in the CSR module (CSRFile/CSRMap), or is instantiated but hardwired to zero/unimplemented without trap-side write logic (e.g., missing mcause/mepc/mtval update on exception entry, missing mscratch read/write path), the hardware fails to provide mandatory M-mode trap infrastructure. Specifically: (a) mscratch absent → M-mode handler loses context-swap capability; (b) mepc absent or not updated on trap entry → MRET returns to wrong/undefined address, breaking all trap return paths; (c) mcause absent or not updated on trap entry → M-mode handler cannot determine trap reason, making traps undispatched or misdispatched; (d) mtval absent or not updated on exception → page fault handlers lose faulting virtual address, breaking demand paging and memory management.
security_spec.summary: mscratch/mepc/mcause/mtval are now spec-mandatory M-mode CSRs; if any is missing or non-updating in XiangShan CSR RTL, M-mode trap handling collapses: MRET returns to garbage PC, trap dispatch breaks, page faults become unrecoverable, and M-mode context switching fails — functionally bricking M-mode and enabling privilege-boundary violations

findings.finding: All four mandatory M-mode trap CSRs (mscratch, mepc, mcause, mtval) are instantiated as proper CSRModule instances with correct addresses (0x340-0x343) matching the RISC-V privileged spec. Each has a full read/write path through the CSRModule framework.
findings.snippet:
val mscratch = Module(new CSRModule("Mscratch", new ScratchBundle(...)).setAddr(CSRs.mscratch)
val mepc = Module(new CSRModule("Mepc", new Epc) with TrapEntryMEventSinkBundle).setAddr(CSRs.mepc)
val mcause = Module(new CSRModule("Mcause", new CauseBundle) with TrapEntryMEventSinkBundle).setAddr(CSRs.mcause)
val mtval = Module(new CSRModule("Mtval", new XtvalBundle) with TrapEntryMEventSinkBundle).setAddr(CSRs.mtval)

findings.finding: Trap entry correctly updates all three trap-capture CSRs: mepc (PC of trapped instruction, bit 0 cleared), mcause (Interrupt bit + ExceptionCode), and mtval (faulting address or additional info). All writes are guarded by the valid signal.
findings.snippet:
out.mepc.valid := valid
out.mcause.valid := valid
out.mtval.valid := valid
out.mepc.bits.epc := Mux(isFetchMalAddr, in.fetchMalTval(63, 1), trapPC(63, 1))
out.mcause.bits.Interrupt := isInterrupt && !isDTExcp
out.mcause.bits.ExceptionCode := Mux(isDTExcp, ExceptionNO.EX_DT.U, highPrioTrapNO)
out.mtval.bits.ALL := Mux(isFetchMalAddrExcp, in.fetchMalTval, tval)

findings.finding: MRET correctly reads mepc as the return target PC, ensuring the trap return path is functional. Address translation checks (IPF, IAF, IGPF) are applied to the return target.

mepc Epc bundle defines field at bits 63:1 (bit 0 hardwired to zero), matching the RISC-V spec requirement that mepc[0] is always zero (traps target aligned instruction addresses, and mret with mepc[0]=1 would raise an instruction-address-misaligned exception).
mcause CauseBundle correctly encodes Interrupt at bit 63 and ExceptionCode at bits 62:0, matching RISC-V privileged spec encoding (WLRL field where bit 63 distinguishes interrupts from exceptions).
CSR address map correctly assigns spec-mandated addresses: mscratch=0x340, mepc=0x341, mcause=0x342, mtval=0x343. These match the RISC-V privileged architecture CSR address assignments exactly.
findings.snippet:
val mscratch = 0x340
val mepc = 0x341
val mcause = 0x342
val mtval = 0x343

findings.finding: All four CSRs are registered in machineLevelCSRMods sequence, ensuring they are included in the csrOutMap for CSR read instructions, exported to difftest state, and participate in the full CSR infrastructure.
All four CSRs are exported to difftest DiffCSRState for architectural state verification (used by difftest framework to check against golden model), confirming they hold live architectural state.
findings.snippet:
diffCSRState.mepc := mepc.rdata.asUInt
diffCSRState.mtval := mtval.rdata.asUInt
diffCSRState.mcause := mcause.rdata.asUInt
diffCSRState.mscratch := mscratch.rdata.asUInt
